units.source_text: 在我離家出走的那一天，明明是他讓我更加孤單，我卻無法拒絕這個男人，只能笑臉相迎。

en.t: On the day I ran away from home, even though he was the one who had made me feel even lonelier, I could not refuse this man and could only greet him with a smile.

units.source_text: 「聽人說，你小子的漫畫頗受歡迎，業餘畫家就是有一股‘初生牛犢不怕虎’的膽量啊。

en.t: I hear your comics are fairly popular. Amateur artists really do have the reckless nerve of calves that do not fear tigers.

units.source_text: 不過，你可不要太自以為是啊，因為你的素描一點也不成樣子。」

en.t: But do not get too full of yourself, because your sketching is not worth a thing.

units.source_text: 他在我面前擺出一副師匠姿態，要是把我的那些「妖怪畫」拿給他看，他會做出何種表情呢？

en.t: He struck a masterly pose before me; if I showed him those monster pictures of mine, what sort of face would he make?

units.source_text: 我重複著以往的徒勞焦慮，說：「別這樣說嘛，我難過得都快要尖叫了。」

en.t: Repeating my old futile anxiety, I said, Do not say that; it makes me so miserable I could almost scream.

units.source_text: 堀木越發得意地說道：「若只說謀生之道的本領，總有一天你的缺陷會暴露出來。」

en.t: Horiki said with even greater self-satisfaction, If all you have is the knack of getting by in the world, sooner or later your flaws will show.
